data.title: CATL introduces 100kWh ’30#’ swappable battery for passenger cars
data.description: CATL has introduced a new battery pack for its battery-swapping ecosystem in China. The "30#" battery block offers a capacity of 100 kWh and can be swapped in under a minute. Alternatively, the swappable battery can also be fast-charged at a conventional charging station.

data.title: Porsche Boxster goes electric: our test drive of the prototype
data.description: In our first test drive, the electric Porsche Boxster demonstrated how it aims to win the hearts of petrolheads as the brand's first E-Roadster. With over 500 hp, a sprint in under three seconds, and a battery replacing the mid-engine, it navigates through the city, countryside, and mountain passes. Added to this are sound and shifting scenarios - and a price that is set to be significantly lower than that of the 911.

data.title: Audi E7X Becomes First Model of China Sub-Brand with Range Extender
data.description: The Chinese Ministry of Industry and Information Technology (MIIT) has listed a new version of the AUDI E7X. This is the first model with a range extender from Audi's Chinese sub-brand. It is produced by SAIC Volkswagen.

data.title: Hyundai unveils compact Ioniq SUV for China – with swappable batteries
data.description: Hyundai is presenting another study from its Ioniq series, tailored specifically for the Chinese market, at the Auto Guangzhou trade show. The Mercury Concept is an intelligent B-segment SUV that is set to go on sale as a production model as early as 2027. In one version, it will also feature swappable batteries.

data.title: More Stellantis plants face production halt in France
data.description: Stellantis is once again temporarily halting production for several weeks at its Sochaux, Rennes, and Mulhouse plants in France - citing the "challenging European market, aggressive competition, and a complicated geopolitical situation".

data.title: Changan Subsidiary Avatr Expands into Switzerland
data.description: Avatr enters the Swiss market in 2027 with the 07L and 06T models. Kamps Import AG will handle distribution alongside Schmohl AG, with prices starting around 59,900 CHF (approx. €65,500) and deliveries scheduled for spring 2027.

data.title: IONNA opens 22-bay charging hub in California and adds Tesla Autocharge
data.description: US charging network IONNA has opened a new flagship site in Westminster, California, featuring 22 charging bays with peak power of up to 400 kW. The opening coincides with the expansion of automatic charging authentication to Tesla vehicles, with support for models from Stellantis brands set to follow in December.

data.title: Volvo marks 50th anniversary of its first electric car
data.description: The automotive future arrived in 1976 in butter yellow, drove a maximum of 70 km/h, and needed a ten-hour break after 50 kilometres. Half a century ago, Volvo introduced its first electric car: the Elbil.

data.title: Subaru E-Outback to launch in UK from £49,995
data.description: Subaru has confirmed UK pricing for its new all-electric flagship, the E-Outback, with the electric SUV starting at £49,995. The Japanese manufacturer is offering four trim levels, with initial customer deliveries scheduled for early 2027.

data.title: Mercedes-Benz GLA test drive: compact SUV with 800-volt architecture and two-tonne towing capacity
data.description: The new Mercedes-Benz GLA 350 4MATIC electric sets technical benchmarks in the crowded compact electric SUV segment. With its 800-volt architecture, 85-kWh battery, and two-speed transmission, the all-wheel-drive model combines high efficiency with short charging stops. A large frunk, a two-ton towing capacity, and the new MB.OS operating system also enhance its everyday practicality.

data.title: Allego secures financing package of up to €720 million euros
data.description: Dutch charging infrastructure operator Allego announces it has secured financing of nearly three-quarters of a billion euros. The company continues to face high capital requirements - especially in light of its UK expansion plans.

data.title: Envoy and LACI launch EV car-sharing initiative in New Jersey
data.description: The partners will deploy up to 30 shared EVs in Hudson and Bergen counties. An $8.5 million (around €7.8 million) state grant funds the project to expand electric mobility in underserved communities.

data.title: Nissan recognises Aviloo’s battery tests
data.description: Nissan Automotive Europe has recognised Austrian battery diagnostics specialist Aviloo as an independent provider for assessing the battery condition of used EVs. The company's battery certificates can thus be used as part of Nissan's Certified Pre-Owned (CPO) used car program.

data.title: Stagecoach brings 21 electric buses into service in North Devon
data.description: Stagecoach South West has introduced 21 battery-electric buses to the southwestern UK county, thus marking the first phase of its electric bus rollout across the county. The new vehicles have entered service from the operator's Barnstaple depot, following earlier deployments in Exeter and Torbay.

data.title: Kim Long Motor delivers 100 electric sleeper buses in Vietnam
data.description: Vietnamese electric commercial vehicle manufacturer Kim Long Motor has handed over a fleet of 100 electric sleeper buses to Futa Bus Lines, a major homegrown bus operator based in Ho Chi Minh City. The latter has put them into service on intercity routes.

data.title: Zenobē expands into Germany
data.description: British commercial fleet electrification specialist Zenobē is bringing its offerings to Germany. Zenobē provides fleet operators with a fixed-price solution that includes EVs, charging infrastructure, battery management, and fleet management software.

data.title: UK energy price cap increase could add up to £9 to EV charging costs
data.description: Charging an electric car at home could become noticeably more expensive in the UK from January, as a sharp rise in energy prices threatens to erode some of the cost advantages of running an EV. The impact will depend heavily on the driver's energy supplier and tariff, with households on standard variable deals facing the biggest immediate challenge.

data.title: KAIST aims to extend the lifespan of anode-free batteries
data.description: Researchers at the South Korean Korea Advanced Institute of Science and Technology (KAIST) have developed an approach to extend the lifespan of anode-free lithium-metal batteries. They are leveraging a manufacturing process from the semiconductor industry and a coating just ten nanometers thick.

data.title: Volvo A40 Electric begins first construction site deployment
data.description: Four electric articulated haulers of the Volvo A40 Electric type have begun their first construction site deployment at the British infrastructure project Lower Thames Crossing. The vehicles can each transport up to 39 tonnes of construction material. The charging electricity is generated on-site from green hydrogen.

data.title: VW and Elli launch €1,995 V2G BiDi wallbox
data.description: Volkswagen and its energy subsidiary Elli will introduce their first Vehicle-to-Grid package to the German market in December 2026. The requisite DC wallbox will cost €1,995 euros. In addition to VW, VW Commercial Vehicles, and Cupra, Skoda will also be included in the launch. Details about the electricity tariff have also been announced.
